# Fixtures for `m3u` (M3U playlist)

Every file here was made for whiff's tests and is released under CC0-1.0. Titles, artists,
paths and hosts (Saltmere Brass Band, Mira Castell, Ben Gull, `*.example`) are fictitious; the
media behind any manifest were a few seconds of a test pattern and a sine tone, and are not kept.
Regenerate with `scripts/fixtures/subtitles.sh`.

| File | Origin | Licence |
|---|---|---|
| `channels-crafted.m3u8` | Written by `scripts/fixtures/craft_subtitles.py`: an IPTV channel list (`tvg-*`, `group-title`) | CC0-1.0 |
| `plain-paths-crafted.m3u` | Written by `scripts/fixtures/craft_subtitles.py`: paths only, no header | CC0-1.0 |
| `saltmere-evenings-crafted.m3u` | Written by `scripts/fixtures/craft_subtitles.py`: extended M3U with titles, albums, a stream | CC0-1.0 |
